what: Hand-drawn props beside sections (people · animals · stalls) start once they enter above the bottom 15% of the screen, then repeat every 5s — at 45%→50% of the beat they jump 20px up at 1.05x, land at 60%, and rest for the remainder (cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275) bounce-back)

options.height: Jump height (px), default 20 — 0 only scales up in place
options.delay: Wait before the first beat (s), default 0 — in the original it was staggered 0, 1, 2 per prop

note: The original is .js-easing-scale.roop — it first pops out with a .5s bounce from .5x scale (used together with back-pop-in), then repeats a hop

from.where: index.html .hm-exp-list__ill · .hm-news__ill · the walking person on the mountain strip (.ts-pop.is-loop · d1 · d2) — original @keyframes bounce 5s, animation-delay 1s · 2s
